0022600169.text: Denver (3-2, 4th in the Northwest and 9th in the West) hosts Portland (3-1, 2nd in the Northwest and 4th in the West), with the Nuggets on a two-game winning streak and the Trail Blazers coming off a loss. Denver will be without Alpha Diallo (personal), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Nuggets won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 137-132 win in Denver on April 6, 2026.
